Title: Diablerie and Taking the Skin: Minion

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
Can a vampire who commits diablerie and gains a skill card for inferior Abombwe play Taking the Skin: Minion this action?

Taking the Skin: Minion
[Abombwe] Abombwe
[abo] [REFLEX] Cancel a frenzy card played on this vampire as it is played.
[abo] [ACTION MODIFIER][COMBAT] Skin. Play when this vampire burns a minion. Put this card on this vampire and untap him or her. This vampire may bleed an additional time this turn and gets +1 bleed and +1 stealth when bleeding. Burn this card during your discard phase. A minion can have only one skin.

When you are anvil, be patient; when a hammer, strike.
